name: Custom server (any game)
description: The escape hatch: run any install script and any start command. Use it for games without a template, custom modpacks, bots, or anything else that needs supervising.

variables.name: INSTALL_SCRIPT
variables.label: Install script (bash)
variables.default: echo 'Nothing to install — upload your files with the file manager.'
variables.description: Runs once in the server directory. Helpers available: gp_fetch URL DEST, gp_extract FILE, gp_apt PKG, gp_ensure_java 21, gp_steam_app APPID.

variables.name: LAUNCH_COMMAND
variables.label: Start command
variables.description: Runs in the server directory. Use {{PORT}} for the allocated port.

variables.name: STOP_COMMAND
variables.label: Stop command (optional)
variables.description: Written to the process stdin on stop. Leave empty to use SIGTERM.
